name: hyppovisor
description: Electron companion app that opens any URL in an authenticated tab and exposes it over MCP

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.js
scripts.start: node scripts/postinstall.js --strict && npm run build && electron .
scripts.dist: node scripts/dist-preflight.js && npm run build && npm run licenses:check && npm run licenses:gen && electron-builder --mac
